headline: Revenue grows year over year, profit cools sequentially
summary_short: Masimo reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $403.6M, up 8.5% y/y but down 2.2% q/q; net income of $57.1M swung to a profit from a $170.7M year-ago loss, though down 16.4% q/q from $68.3M.
summary_long: Revenue was $403.6M, up 8.5% y/y from $372M but down 2.2% q/q from $412.5M. Gross profit rose 7.2% y/y to $250.8M (+1.4% q/q). Operating income fell 4.1% y/y to $77.4M (-7.7% q/q); EBITDA was roughly flat y/y at $85.5M (-10.1% q/q). Net income of $57.1M swung positive from a $170.7M loss a year ago, though down 16.4% q/q from $68.3M. Diluted EPS was $1.09 versus a $3.17 loss per share a year ago; basic EPS was $1.10. No cash-position KPI is carried on this shard.
